newsitem.title: INDIA: Gandhi heir embroiled in bizarre "marriage" case.
newsitem.headline: Gandhi heir embroiled in bizarre "marriage" case.

text.p: The daughter of former prime minister Rajiv Gandhi, often regarded as his political heir, was involved in a bizarre court case on Thursday after a man claimed to have married her.

The Press Trust of India (PTI) said a Delhi court rejected an appeal by Priyanka Gandhi, 25, in which she had asked the court to throw out the claim by V. Ramakrishna Goud that he had married her in 1991.
PTI said Gandhi in fact planned to marry Delhi businessman Robert Wadhera on February 5 but was forced to go to the court after Goud claimed she could not do so as she was still his wife.
Goud told a court in the southern state of Andhra Pradesh last month, after a Delhi newspaper reported Gandhi's plans to marry Wadhera, that he was already married to her.
Newspapers have quoted Goud as citing undisclosed "proof" of his marriage with Gandhi which he says is still valid.
It was not clear why Goud had kept the "marriage" secret.
But PTI said Civil Judge Vipin Gupta rejected Gandhi's plea because she had failed to sign a relevant legal paper.
Gupta asked her to file a fresh petition by January 27 when he is expected to pronounce a verdict.
Congress sources close to Gandhi's family said she was confident of going ahead with her wedding in February, suggesting she was sure of winning her appeal against Goud's claim.
PTI quoted Gandhi's lawyers as describing Goud's claim as "false and frivoulous".
After Rajiv Gandhi was killed by a woman suicide bomber in May 1991, senior leaders of his Congress party turned to his Italian-born widow Sonia Gandhi to become the party's president.
But the media-shy and self-effacing Sonia Gandhi has kept largely aloof from public life.

Some newspapers have said that Priyanka Gandhi, who they liken to her grandmother and former prime minister Indira Gandhi, was the next choice for the Congress to keep the Nehru-Gandhi dynasty in the country's political limelight.
Priyanka Gandhi has a 27-year old brother. But Congress sources say he is not interested in politics.
Congress politicians said Gandhi's chances of leading the party in the future would not be affected by Goud's claim.
